paper.title: Algorithms for incomplete elliptic integrals (ACM TOMS Algorithm 577: RC, RF, RD, RJ; symmetric incomplete elliptic integrals)

claim.text: RJ(2,3,4,5) from the Algorithm 577 subroutine RJ, called with ERRTOL = 1.D-3 by the RJ test driver (check value in the driver comment: 0.14297 57966 71567 53833 23308). Registered tol_abs 1.4297579667156755e-4 (ERRTOL 1e-3 times the value).

reference.archive: netlib.org/toms/577.gz sha256 61ac0a82555128503bb1c0e7ad1b1911534377e0d1bb407a794579c4d2272c0e (lines 805-844: RJ driver with the check-value comment; set 22 at archive line 867)

attempt: Original as shipped: one gfortran compile of the single archive file fails (two unnamed main programs, 'Error: Two main PROGRAMs'). Workaround with no tree edit: verbatim line ranges copied into the build directory: RC (27-128), RJ (392-536) as a library; the RJ test driver (805-844) as the program; its 42 input sets (846-887) on stdin. Output row for set 22 (X,Y,Z,P = 2,3,4,5) gives RJ = 0.1429757966715675.

original_attempt.reason: The archive's single file holds six unnamed main programs (four subroutines then six test drivers, as its own header states); gfortran reports 'Two main PROGRAMs' at link/compile, so no single executable exists as shipped.
